Outsiders might be surprised to learn how well-populated the trap actually is, in the case of cold fusion and LENR. Some, including a team at one of Italyâ€™s leading research centres, say that they have many replications of the Fleischmann and Pons results.

Again, the explanation for ignoring these claims cannot be that other attempts failed 25 years ago. That makes no sense at all. Rather, itâ€™s the reputation trap.
